All 3 implementation-companions.json entries (implementation-ux.html, implementation-sequence.html, implementation-components.html) contain 'Live acceptance pending user manual testing' and reference implementation-definitions.json, each >1000 bytes — verified directly via Grep/Read.

checks.check: Record genuine VSCode/JetBrains evidence without deprecated-fork work or fake positive prerequisite statuses.
checks.evidence: consumer-inventory.json externalPrerequisites are all 'pending' or 'pending-user-manual' (S001, providerService, positiveSavedWorkerAffinity, SQLServer, VSCodeLiveUI, JetBrainsLiveUI) — none are forced positive. UI-FEEDBACK.md contains no mention of the deprecated insrc-ide fork (grep found nothing).

checks.check: Shipped production admission stays fail-closed while S001/provider/positive Saved worker affinity/SQLServer or genuine client acceptance remains pending; historical S003/S004 failures preserved.
checks.evidence: consumer-inventory.json: releaseEnabled=false, producerPolicyModified=false, historicalFailures.S003 {failed:8, skipped:134, todo:3} and S004 {failed:21, skipped:134, todo:3} retained verbatim. The CM-S5-GATE test independently calls connectionManagementEnablement() (unmodified src/daemon/db/management-enablement.ts) and asserts ready=false both with no scopes and with sc5/sc6, and proves a forged gates.json with ready:true still resolves to ready=false.

checks.check: Only S005 consumer inventory/evidence and artifact alignment are in scope. Existing producer prerequisites and backend gate policy are consumed unchanged; no forced positive status, new enablement switch or clearing pending S001/provider/worker/SQLServer findings.
checks.evidence: src/daemon/db/management-enablement.ts (the producer gate policy) is untouched by this change — it is not in git status's modified-file list, and the CM-S5-GATE test consumes it as-is, asserting the forged-evidence negative control still fails closed.

verdict.reason: Both named tests exist in src/shared/__tests__/connection-manager-release.test.ts and genuinely exercise what their names claim (gate fail-closed negative controls; artifact/companion content agreement with honest limits), the daemon reports both passing and typecheck clean, and every acceptance check is backed by concrete evidence in the S005 artifacts. The other working-tree diffs (chat-panel.ts/test.ts, design/chat-panel-provider-model-effort.md, mocks/model-tiers-grouped.html) are confirmed unrelated — their own comments tag them to a different epic's 'Story S005' (E20261014613abdb3, the dev-chat history feature), not this Connections epic's S005/t30, so they are not in scope for this task.</reason>
